title: Identifier
description: A locally-unique identifier for this span.

title: Name
description: A name for this span. The name should be unique amongst the spans belonging to a network.

title: Status
description: The status of the network infrastructure for this span, from the closed [spanStatus codelist](https://standard.ofds.info/en/{{version}}/reference/codelists#spanstatus).

title: Ready for service date
description: The date this span was ready to carry traffic. For spans with multiple network providers, the earliest of the dates at which each provider's network was ready to carry traffic on this span.

title: Directed
description: Whether this span is directed. If the span is directed, the span begins at the node referenced in `.start` and ends at the node referenced in `.end`. Otherwise, the span connects the nodes referenced in `.start` and `.end` with no direction implied.

title: Route
description: The physical route that this span takes between the nodes that it connects.

title: Type
description: The type of supporting infrastructure, from the open [spanSupportingInfrastructure codelist](https://standard.ofds.info/en/{{version}}/reference/codelists#spansupportinginfrastructure).

title: Description
description: A description of the supporting infrastructure for this span.

title: Spare capacity
description: Whether the supporting infrastructure has spare capacity for the installation of additional fibre cables.

title: Codeployment
description: The type of utility or transport infrastrucutre with which this span is codeployed.

title: Cable type
description: The type of cable used in this span.

title: Dark fibre availability
description: Whether access to dark fibre is available on this span.

title: Fibre type
description: The type of fibre used in this span, from the closed [fibreType codelist](https://standard.ofds.info/en/{{version}}/reference/codelists#fibretype). Further details of the span's fibre type can be provided in `.fibreTypeDetails`.

title: Subtype
description: The sub-category of this span's fibre type. For example, G.652.B.

title: Description
description: A description of this span's fibre type.

title: Fibre count
description: The number of individual optical fibres in this span.

title: Fibre length
description: The physical length in kilometres, of fibre optic cable used in this span.

title: Equipped capacity
description: The transmission rate, or throughput, of this span, expressed in Gbit/sec (Gbps). The equipped capacity is the total capacity of the circuits (e.g. E1, DS3, STM-1 etc.) which have been activated in the network transmission equipment of the span. For spans with multiple network providers, the sum of the capacity of each provider's network on this span. Further details of this span's capacity can be provided in `.capacityDetails`. For more information, see [equipped capacity](https://standard.ofds.info/en/{{version}}/reference/data_model/#equipped-capacity).

title: Description
description: A description of this span's capacity.
